integration_notes: T09 owns package exports, report/CLI wiring and complete paper correspondence. No shared files were changed here.
Model ID excludes NBER and post-hoc indicator annotations. Analysis ID includes displayed NBER/indicator evidence.
State is full_sample scope only and cannot pass a rolling scope guard.
GMM labels are aligned by Hungarian distance between empirical PCA regime means and GMM means, without NBER.
Figure 4 uses raw means explicitly; separate transformed heatmap and both sets of observed-only statistics are saved.
Figure/table records use paper_id values Figure 1 through Figure 6 and Table 1; elbow and transformed indicators are supplements.
Output directories must not already exist. Raw and all previous evidence remain unchanged.
reported_method_limits: R0 contains only April 2020 in this sample. It is the smaller L2 cluster and is not NBER recession ground truth.
PCA count 52 differs from the paper value 61. This is an actual public-snapshot method re-execution, not matching-paper-number certification.
Raw economic levels can reflect secular trends. Source base years/units are not inferred, and absent series are never replaced.
No paper economic regime labels or path-shaped graph layout are imposed. Descriptions remain sample dependent.
